directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: Wow! Look who it is! Wolf! What brings you up here?!
entries.JA_current: Wow! Look who it is! Wolf! What brings you up here?!
entries.JA_new: これは驚いた！ ウルフじゃないか。こんなところまで何しに来た？

entries.EN: My old good fellow, Skull, asked for help. He used to be in Duty but got into a quarrel with his seniors, or something like that. He's going to put an end to those anarchists, but he lacks ammunition and equipment for that. So, he asked me to help him out of friendship and bring him some explosives. Well, so happened I had a stash of dynamite on hand so I agreed to deliver it, the very same crate I asked you to fetch for me. Besides, I was getting real bored of the quiet life at the Cordon after you cleaned the area up so I welcomed the opportunity to do another deep raid into the Zone, see my old pals, maybe pick up some loot. I left the rookies in capable hands, a friend of mine called Fanatic came down to stay for a while so I asked him to keep an eye on the camp.

entries.JA_new: 昔なじみのスカルに助けを頼まれてな。あいつは昔デューティーにいたが、上の連中と揉めたか何かで抜けたんだ。今度はあの無政府主義者どもを始末するつもりらしいが、弾薬も装備も足りない。だから友情に免じて、爆薬を持ってきてくれと頼まれた。ちょうどダイナマイトの隠しがあったんで、運ぶことにした。お前に取ってきてもらった、あの箱だよ。それに、お前が辺りを片付けてから、コルドンで静かに暮らすのにも飽きてきてな。ゾーンの奥までまた遠征できる機会だ。昔の仲間に会って、ついでに何か拾ってくるのも悪くない。新米たちは信頼できる奴に任せてきた。ファナティックって友人がしばらくこっちに来てるんで、キャンプを見てもらってる。

entries.EN: I see. So, I wonder, why does your buddy need dynamite?
entries.JA_current: I see. So, I wonder, why does your buddy need dynamite?
entries.JA_new: なるほどな。それで、その仲間は何のためにダイナマイトを？

entries.EN: Haven't got the slightest idea. He's become very strange recently, getting real pissed off with those Freedom stoners. I'm kinda afraid he'll just get himself and his men killed for nothing... His lads will follow him to the grave, they obey every order he gives, even if it doesn't make much sense.
entries.JA_current: Haven't got the slightest idea. He's become very strange recently, getting real pissed off with those Freedom stoners. I'm kinda afraid he'll just get himself and his men killed for nothing... His lads will follow him to the grave, they obey every order he gives, even if it doesn't make much sense.
entries.JA_new: さあな。さっぱり分からん。最近あいつは妙に変わっちまった。フリーダムのラリった連中にひどく腹を立ててる。何のためにもならずに、本人も部下も死なせる気じゃないかと心配だ……部下たちはあいつのためなら死ぬまでついていく。意味が分からない命令でも、全部従うんだ。
個人的な事情みたいだな……

entries.EN: That's right. Listen, Marked One, if you meet Skull some day - better stay away from him just to be safe.
entries.JA_current: That's right. Listen, Marked One, if you meet Skull some day - better stay away from him just to be safe.
entries.JA_new: そうだな。聞いてくれ、印付き。いつかスカルに会ったら、念のため近づかないほうがいい。
分かった、忠告ありがとう。
